wol_computer.title: Wake-on-LAN through another computer
wol_computer.description: Choose a computer that is always on and in the same network as this one. It will send the magic packet (needs `wakeonlan` or `python3`).

wol_mikrotik.title: Wake-on-LAN through a MikroTik router
wol_mikrotik.description:
The router of this computer's network sends the magic packet with `/tool wol`.

Create a restricted user on the router (RouterOS terminal):

```
{command}
```

The key `/config/.ssh/gnulinux_mikrotik` was generated for this. Leave the password empty to use only the key.

wol_ha_mikrotik.title: Wake-on-LAN through a MikroTik of Home Assistant
wol_ha_mikrotik.description: Uses the connection of the MikroTik integration (`/tool/wol`). The API user of the router needs the **test** policy.
